title: CTRES v1.1 stream checkpoint
description: The checkpoint of a stream for a gaming day, or for an hour where the profile says so (§8.4): the range of sequences it covers and the chain hash of the event lines as transmitted. It is emitted as an event of the stream (record_type checkpoint, op create) at least once per gaming day per stream, and the period package lists the checkpoints of its period in the manifest under stream_checkpoints, so that the package can be reconciled with the stream (§8.2; §11). Integrity rests on the transport, the sequence numbers and this hash; no event is hashed or signed on its own.

stream_id.description: Identifier of the stream the checkpoint covers, as in the event envelope (§8.4).

licence_number.description: Licence the stream reports under, as in the manifest (§8.4; §8.2).

period_start.description: Start of the gaming day or hour the checkpoint covers (§8.4; §5 Submission checkpoint).

period_end.description: End of the gaming day or hour the checkpoint covers (§8.4).

first_sequence.description: First sequence of the stream the checkpoint covers (§8.4).

last_sequence.description: Last sequence of the stream the checkpoint covers; one below first_sequence where the period had no events (§8.4).

event_count.description: Number of sequences covered: last_sequence − first_sequence + 1, nothing deducted; a gap in the sequence is a finding, not a deduction (§8.4).

chain_hash.description: SHA-256, as 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters, of the concatenation of the UTF-8 bytes of the event lines first_sequence to last_sequence as transmitted, each line followed by a line feed (U+000A), checkpoint events excluded (§8.4; §3 Deterministic and verifiable).

signature.description: Detached signature over the checkpoint made with the operator's certificate, where the profile requires one (§8.4; §8.2 signature_file).

previous_checkpoint_hash.description: The chain_hash of the previous checkpoint of the stream, so that the checkpoints form a chain (§8.4).
